metadata.description: Monitoring and evaluation document reviews for Claude.

plugins.name: me-review
plugins.description: Twelve structured M&E document reviews: logframes, theories of change, indicators, evaluation TORs, M&E plans, proposals, sampling plans, surveys, baseline reports, progress reports, data quality assessments, and evaluation reports. Each returns section-by-section PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL ratings, a summary verdict, and prioritized recommendations.
